comment: Canonical home: iguana-rs/editors/vscode/syntaxes/iggy.tmLanguage.json. The website repo vendors a byte-identical copy at syntaxes/iggy.tmLanguage.json; keep the two in sync. Token roles mirror iggy/iggy.iggy and iguana-lsp/src/semantic_tokens.rs: in editors, LSP semantic tokens override these scopes once the server is up; this grammar covers the pre-LSP window, markdown fences, and static rendering.
name: iggy

annotation.comment: Rule annotations: @Regex, @Layout, @NoLayout, @WithLayout. Scoped as a decorator (the Python/Java convention) so VS Code-family themes give them the decorator color Terrarium uses.
annotation.name: entity.name.function.decorator.iggy

label.comment: Alternative labels like #Add. Scoped under comment. so themes render them muted, matching iguana-lsp, which deliberately emits labels as COMMENT tokens.
label.name: comment.label.iggy

char-class.comment: Regex character classes like [0-9] or [a-zA-Z_]. Scoped under string.regexp so themes give them their regex color; iguana-lsp likewise emits these as REGEXP tokens.
char-class.name: string.regexp.character-class.iggy

field.comment: Field names bound to a symbol, e.g. lhs:Expr

keyword.comment: The full keyword set, per Keyword in iggy.iggy

nonterminal.comment: Every remaining identifier is a grammar symbol; iguana-lsp colors all of them as TYPE
nonterminal.name: entity.name.type.iggy
